title: Snow Mountain Ski Patrol
premise: A mentor-apprentice drama at a ridge patrol station and a treeline rescue pad. Luzhu and A-Yao are easily confused; the avalanche probe goes intact→bent→realigned-reassembled; Snow Fox crashes off a cliff and must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Stateful entities use states; stateless use appearance. On transition, inject only the current state's appearance.

states.prime_on_duty: Snow-mountain patrolman Zheng He in his thirties, square face and short beard, bright-red patrol jacket and black snow pants, radio on the chest, steady stride.
states.frostbite_weary: The same Zheng He: jacket cuffs iced, frostbite scab on the right cheek, walking slowly on ski poles, gaze heavy.
states.deceased: Zheng He has closed his eyes in death, lying still on a camp cot in the mountain-hut clinic, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_apprentice: Young Luzhu: a lean patrol apprentice around fifteen, fluorescent-yellow strip on the helmet, oversized red jacket, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Luzhu: a broader-shouldered patrolman in his twenties, still with fluorescent-yellow strip on the helmet, red jacket fitted, calm eyes.

states.intact: A two-meter red aluminum avalanche probe, section locks bright, grip wrapped in nonslip tape.
states.shaft_bent: The same avalanche probe bent mid-shaft, locks sprung open, grip tape cracked and iced.
states.realigned_reassembled: After realignment the avalanche probe's locks are refitted, grip rewrapped with new tape, ready to probe again.

states.intact: A waterproof-zip patrol logbook, orange cover, pages recording snow conditions and wind speed in neat hand.
states.snowmelt_ruined: The same patrol logbook ruined by snowmelt, cover whitened and wrinkled, writing bled.

states.intact: An orange-and-white snowmobile 'Snow Fox', fox emblem sprayed on the nose, tracks clean, rescue sled tied to the rear seat.
states.cliff_wrecked: After sliding off an ice ridge, Snow Fox is twisted, tracks broken, fox emblem buried in snow.

states.young_rival: Young patrolman A-Yao nearly identical in face to Luzhu, but a deep-blue wind scarf, fluorescent-green sleeve badge over the jacket, bold expression.
states.disguised: Disguised A-Yao still wears the deep-blue wind scarf, sleeve badge swapped to matte black, expression deeper.

E7.name: ridge patrol station
E7.appearance: A high ridge patrol station, wood-and-stone hut roofed with snow, wind sock by the door, warm yellow light in the window.

E8.name: treeline rescue pad
E8.appearance: A rescue pad at the treeline, packed snow marked for landing, frost on surrounding spruce, sleds and stretchers parked.

E9.name: crevasse narrows
E9.appearance: A crevasse narrows on the glacier, blue ice walls on both sides, aluminum walk boards underfoot, cutting cold.

E10.name: abandoned cable-car station
E10.appearance: An abandoned cable-car station on the mountainside, rusted cable wheel stopped, knee-deep snow on the platform, peeling plaster showing brick seams.

E11.name: patrol memorial plaque
E11.appearance: An aluminum memorial plaque nailed to the patrol-station doorpost, engraved with 'Zheng He' and enlistment year, ice crystals at the corners.

E12.name: snow-condition flags
E12.appearance: Three snow-condition flags at the rescue-pad edge—green, yellow, black—edges frayed by wind.

E13.name: orange-red snowmobile
E13.appearance: A brand-new orange-red snowmobile sprayed 'Temporary Support', no fox emblem—utterly unlike Snow Fox.

E14.name: resort safety officer
E14.appearance: A lean resort safety officer in an orange knit cap and yellow reflective vest, build somewhat like Zheng He's, but resort crest on the sleeve.

E15.name: storm oil lamps
E15.appearance: A row of five storm oil lamps on iron hooks on the patrol-station beam, glass covers polished bright.

E16.name: shift-change brass bells
E16.appearance: Two shift-change brass bells under the patrol-station eaves, tongues muffling when iced.

E17.name: Xiaoxue
E17.appearance: New intern patrolman Xiaoxue, light-pink headscarf, brand-new red jacket; at a glance like young Luzhu, but sharper chin and shy gaze.

E18.name: spare probe section
E18.appearance: A spare probe section shaped much like the main probe but shorter, black-rubber grip, no nonslip tape.

E19.name: White Wolf
E19.appearance: A blue-gray snowmobile 'White Wolf', broad flat body, wolf-head emblem—not the same as Snow Fox.

features.E2: Luzhu: fluorescent-yellow strip on the helmet, red jacket.
features.E6: A-Yao: face nearly identical to Luzhu, but deep-blue wind scarf and fluorescent-green sleeve badge.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard confuse sample: fluorescent-yellow strip helmet vs deep-blue wind scarf.

scenes.setting: Patrol station at dusk (five storm oil lamps · two shift bells)
actions: At dusk, Zheng He walks into the ridge patrol station with ski poles and draws the avalanche probe for a test probe.

actions.action: A row of five storm oil lamps hangs on the patrol-station beam; Zheng He wipes each glass cover clean.
Two shift-change brass bells hang under the patrol-station eaves; Zheng He taps them lightly, the ring muffled.

actions: Zheng He checks the avalanche probe's locks and nonslip tape, confirming nothing is loose.
Through the hut window, Zheng He watches snow fog surging beyond the ridge.

actions.action: The intact avalanche probe leans by the door, shaft catching the oil lamp's warm light.

actions: Zheng He sits by the stove and rubs his frost-red fingers warm.
A distant avalanche telemetry unit beeps once; he puts his jacket back on.
Zheng He unzips the orange-cover patrol logbook and records that day's snowpack hardness and wind speed.
He sketches the ice-ridge crack direction in the logbook.
Zheng He zips it shut and tucks the patrol logbook back into his chest pocket.

actions.action: The avalanche probe leans by the wall; the metal shaft lights his profile.

actions: He tears a scrap of tape and sticks the radio's loose antenna.

scenes.setting: Rescue pad meets the apprentice (three snow-condition flags)

actions.action: On the morning treeline rescue pad, Zheng He greets the approaching orange-and-white snowmobile Snow Fox.
Young Luzhu jumps down from Snow Fox; the fluorescent-yellow strip on the helmet shines in the snow light.
Zheng He points to three snow-condition flags at the pad edge, teaching Luzhu to read green-yellow-black grades.
Luzhu crouches on the snow, curiously touching the rescue sled's straps.
Zheng He explains to Luzhu that two rings of the shift-change brass bells mean the team must pull back.
Luzhu looks back at intact Snow Fox, eyes full of longing.

actions: Frost falls from the spruce; the two walk the packed snow trail toward the ridge patrol station.
In the crevasse narrows, A-Yao in a deep-blue wind scarf turns from behind a blue ice wall.
A-Yao steps slowly across the aluminum walk boards; the fluorescent-green sleeve badge stands out.
He brushes past a sled crew; the wind scarf snaps in the cold wind.
A-Yao taps the walk board, confirming the locks are set.
He passes the end of the narrows and heads for the treeline.
On the treeline rescue pad, Luzhu and A-Yao stand side by side—one fluorescent-yellow strip helmet, one deep-blue wind scarf.
Luzhu hands A-Yao spare gloves; the two briefly lock eyes.
A-Yao straightens Luzhu's oversized jacket collar, then turns away.
They walk opposite ways along the snow trail, figures crossing among the spruce.
A gust whirls snow grains; only the snow-condition flags snap on the pad.
Months later at night, Zheng He keeps watch alone at the ridge patrol station.

actions.action: He unzips the patrol logbook; snowmelt has ruined the cover, whitened and wrinkled.

actions: Zheng He wipes ice crust from the avalanche probe shaft with a glove.
By the hut window he gazes at warning lights on the black snowfield.

actions.action: The avalanche probe leans quiet by the door, locks beaded with white frost.

actions: A shift-change brass bell knocks half a note in the night wind, then falls silent.
When spring snow melts, day after day Zheng He probes and patrols the ridge.
Another blizzard night, he wraps his jacket tight and keeps watch beside the avalanche probe.
In midsummer soft-snow season, he rotates checks of the crevasse walk boards.
Autumn fog thickens; storm oil-lamp light struggles through snow dust.
On New Year's Eve, Zheng He alone fills the patrol record to the last page.
At spring's start he recalibrates the anemometer and continues the line.
Before heavy-snow season, Zheng He reinforces the rescue-pad flagpoles.
After a cold wave he adds a bucket of melt salt inside the station.
Another year before the mountain closes, he taps ice layer by layer for echo.
On a snowy night off patrol, Zheng He leaves only one storm oil lamp and keeps watch until dawn.
After Awakening of Insects, he rebinds dried logbook pages.
Around Qingming he leads a crew clearing snow from the abandoned cable-car station entrance.

scenes.setting: Daily line patrol (keep stretching the gap)
actions: Zheng He replaces ski-pole tips and checks the anti-slip teeth.
He checks the wind sock and records instantaneous wind direction.

actions.action: He lifts the intact avalanche probe again and makes three short probes.

actions: A snowmobile engine sounds from the treeline; he looks up and listens.
Zheng He drops spent tape into an iron bucket and closes the lid.
At noon break he drinks hot cocoa by the stove; steam fogs the window.
In the afternoon he goes out again to mark new cracks.
At sunset he powers off the radio to charge and bolts the door.

scenes.setting: Rescue-pad patrol (recall flags · White Wolf false friend)
actions: At dawn, Zheng He patrols the treeline rescue pad; Snow Fox still sits inside the marked circle.

actions.action: He crouches to check whether Snow Fox's tracks are iced.
At the pad edge, those three snow-condition flags are still planted in place.
A blue-gray snowmobile White Wolf passes the treeline—wolf-head emblem, not Snow Fox.
Zheng He stands on the rescue pad, logging wind slab piled overnight.
He retightens Snow Fox's rescue-sled straps.

actions: Distant cable-car ironwork turns cold white in the morning light.
At nightfall, Zheng He returns to the ridge patrol station and opens the snowmelt-ruined patrol logbook.
He cross-checks old numbers and adds today's crack lengths.

actions.action: He briefly draws the avalanche probe; the shaft reflects the logbook's wrinkled white cover.

actions: He wipes ice crystals from his face shield.
Mountain wind rises; the hut plank walls creak softly.
Zheng He extinguishes half the row of storm oil lamps, leaving only the one by the bunk.

scenes.setting: Ice-ridge accident (probe bends · Snow Fox falls)
actions: In a blizzard the ice ridge suddenly splits; the ridge patrol station shudders hard.
Gale pours into the hut; storm oil lamps swing violently.

actions.action: In the scramble, the avalanche probe bends mid-shaft and the locks spring open.
On the ice ridge, Snow Fox's tracks slip and the machine pitches hard.
Another crack—Snow Fox slides off the cliff, body twisted, half-buried in snow.
Zheng He rushes from the hut and grips the bent avalanche probe without letting go.

actions: Alarms wail; the radio fills with static.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (Snow Fox indirect cue · oil-lamp recall)

actions.action: The next day when wind eases, Zheng He stands in the patrol station staring at the shaft-bent avalanche probe.
He runs a finger over the sprung lock, face dark.
On a blank page of the patrol logbook he writes the date Snow Fox fell.
A Snow Fox maintenance diagram still sticks on the wall; Zheng He gazes a long time.
He takes one of the five storm oil lamps from the beam and sits alone by its faint light.
The bent avalanche probe leans by the door like a crane with a broken wing.

actions: Distant helicopter rotors skim the spruce tops.

scenes.setting: Realigning the probe (third state · spare-section false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Zheng He brings a bench vise to repair the avalanche probe.

actions.action: From the toolbox he takes a spare probe section—much like the main shaft yet shorter, black-rubber grip.

actions: Zheng He realigns the bent section and refits the locks.

actions.action: Grip rewrapped with new tape, the avalanche probe can probe again.

actions: He makes a short test probe; the shaft drives straight into snow once more.
Zheng He returns the spare probe section to the toolbox so they will not be confused.

scenes.setting: False friends: snowmobile and safety officer

actions.action: An orange-red snowmobile enters the treeline rescue pad, nothing like the cliff-wrecked Snow Fox.
A resort safety officer in an orange knit cap jumps onto the snow pad and talks beside Zheng He; the two are similar in build.
The safety officer points at the orange-red snowmobile, explaining the temporary support roster.
The snowmobile leaves; Zheng He alone on the rescue pad watches it go.

actions: He replants the snow-condition flags straight and walks the snow trail back to the patrol station.

actions.action: Into the crevasse narrows comes intern patrolman Xiaoxue in a light-pink headscarf; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Luzhu.
Xiaoxue practices tying sled rope; Zheng He shakes his head—she is not Luzhu after all.

actions: Xiaoxue lowers her head and steps back; only cold blue-ice light remains in the narrows.

actions.action: Years later at dusk, Zheng He with iced cuffs and frostbitten cheek leans on ski poles beneath the abandoned cable-car station.

actions: He looks up at the rusted cable wheel, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two shift-change brass bells under the distant patrol-station eaves ring softly in the wind; Zheng He pauses to listen.

actions: He lays a palm on the platform's rusted rail, as if saying goodbye.
Fine snow grains fall; the cable-car station grows quieter still.

actions.action: By day, adult Luzhu returns along the snow trail and hurries toward the abandoned cable-car station.
Beneath the cable-car station Luzhu reunites with frostbite-weary Zheng He; the two steady each other.
Beside the mountain-hut clinic camp cot, Luzhu holds Zheng He's gaunt hand.
Zheng He's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and passes away.
Outside the window snow stops; the spruce tops fall silent for an instant.
Zheng He's bright-red jacket still hangs behind the patrol-station door; Luzhu reaches out and gently strokes it.
By the doorpost, adult Luzhu stands before a newly nailed patrol memorial plaque.
Luzhu's fingertips brush Zheng He's name engraved on the aluminum plaque.
He softly speaks the page number of the log where Snow Fox fell, as if answering.

scenes.setting: Again the deceased and destroyed (indirect avoidance)

actions.action: After clearing snow on the treeline rescue pad, Luzhu writes the three characters of Snow Fox in an empty bay, then erases them.
Passing the clinic corridor, he sees Zheng He's old radio in a glass case.

actions: Snow wind skims past; Luzhu grips the fluorescent-yellow strip helmet in his palm.

actions.action: In the dark, Luzhu murmurs a callsign Zheng He once taught toward the empty snow trail.
Disguised A-Yao arrives from the crevasse and briefly locks eyes with Luzhu beneath the abandoned cable-car station.

actions: Luzhu and A-Yao stand side by side by the rusted cable wheel—one calm-eyed, one deep in expression.
A-Yao still wears the deep-blue wind scarf; Luzhu still has the fluorescent-yellow strip helmet.
They stand wordless a moment, then each turns and leaves the cable-car station.

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—the youth who jumped from a snowmobile with a fluorescent-yellow strip on the helmet appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth who jumped from a snowmobile with a fluorescent-yellow strip on the helmet

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the patrol station, a two-meter red alloy probe makes its first test probe.

anchor.phrase: the red alloy probe that first test-probed at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to the crevasse—a figure in a deep-blue wind scarf with a fluorescent-green sleeve badge flashes by.

anchor.phrase: the figure in a deep-blue wind scarf with a fluorescent-green sleeve badge in the crevasse

actions.action: Before the eyes again: that row of five old shaded oil lamps on the patrol-station beam.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old shaded oil lamps on the patrol-station beam

actions.action: Back to the spruce-ringed rescue pad of first meeting; the frost is as it always was.

anchor.phrase: the spruce-ringed rescue pad of first meeting

actions.action: Luzhu opens that snowmelt-ruined patrol logbook again and walks into the ridge patrol station.
At the rescue-pad edge, those three snow-condition flags are still planted.
Luzhu lifts the realigned-reassembled avalanche probe; the shaft drives into snow again.

actions: He cinches his jacket cuffs, nodding confirmation the way Zheng He once did.
In snowfield dusk, a new shift of shift-change brass bells rings softly twice.
At the window Luzhu records tonight's wind speed.
Ridge wind stills; the storm oil-lamp light steadies.
